final_text:
I can't build, validate or release this data product. Creating objects, publishing and scheduling aren't set up here. What I can give you is the definition, proposed SQL and a preview check. All data here is synthetic (the fictional company Northstar Supply).

**Definition (from the catalog)**
- **Measure:** invoiced sales = ExtendedPrice minus TaxAmount, by invoice date. ExtendedPrice includes tax.
- **Rules:** a daily customer/product product must state its date basis, tax treatment and grain. It must not swap in order data for invoices or make up missing dates.
- **Not covered:** currencies, discounts, returns and cancellations aren't modeled.
- **Existing report:** a "Daily invoiced sales" report fixture already exists, but only at date grain. It isn't a real dashboard, and days without invoices are left out.

**Proposed SQL** (not created or deployed)
```sql
SELECT i.INVOICEDATE AS INVOICE_DATE, i.CUSTOMERID, l.STOCKITEMID,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.INVOICEID)          AS INVOICE_COUNT,
       SUM(l.QUANTITY)                      AS INVOICED_QUANTITY,
       SUM(l.EXTENDEDPRICE - l.TAXAMOUNT)   AS SALES_EXCLUDING_TAX,
       SUM(l.TAXAMOUNT)                     AS TAX,
       SUM(l.EXTENDEDPRICE)                 AS TOTAL_INCLUDING_TAX
FROM HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.RAW.INVOICELINES l
JOIN HACKATHON_D2K_PREWORK.RAW.INVOICES i ON i.INVOICEID = l.INVOICEID
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3;
```

**Preview check** (a quick look, not a formal validation or reconciliation)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Rows at the proposed grain | 241 |
| Distinct date/customer/stock item keys | 241 (each key appears once) |
| Rows with a missing key | 0 |
| Date range | 2026-01-05 to 2026-03-03 |
| Sales excluding tax, grain total | 53,589.47 |
| Sales excluding tax, invoice-line total | 53,589.47 (matches) |

To release it, someone with the right permissions would need to deploy the SQL as a view or table, add tests and set up scheduling on their own. I can also run more metric queries or pull other catalog definitions.
